newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen flat awaiting earnings data.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen flat awaiting earnings data.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to stay flat on Thursday as investors seem reluctant to make any price-moving transactions before most companies' monthly earnings reports for September are released on Friday.
Some analysts said the expected good earnings could send the market, currently at 14,908.3 points of the WIG index, up to resistance at 15,200 or even 15,600 points sometime over the next two weeks.
